facts: Automatic evaluation metrics for Machine Translation (MT) systems are now well established.
BLEU is an automatic evaluation metric for Machine Translation (MT) systems.
NIST is an automatic evaluation metric for Machine Translation (MT) systems.
Automatic evaluation metrics for Machine Translation (MT) systems are scarcely used for the assessment of language pairs like English-Chinese.
Automatic evaluation metrics for Machine Translation (MT) systems are scarcely used for the assessment of language pairs like English-Japanese.
This study establishes the equivalence between the standard use of BLEU in word n-grams and BLEU's application at the character level.
The standard use of BLEU is in word n-grams.
BLEU has an application at the character level.
The use of BLEU at the character level eliminates the word segmentation problem.
The use of BLEU at the character level makes it possible to directly compare commercial systems outputting unsegmented texts with statistical MT systems.
Statistical MT systems usually segment their outputs.
